title: Charles Babbage’s Analytical Engine, 1838
version: Annals of the History of Computing 4(3), July 1982, pp. 196–217. DOI 10.1109/MAHC.1982.10028. Trinity College Dublin scan of the original journal issue.
lineage: Bromley reconstructs the machine from the Science Museum’s Babbage papers. He describes his analysis and its limits in the conclusion and acknowledgments. The account explains the matching control structure from the design; it does not identify Babbage’s first contact with a loom.

passages.locator: pp. 197 and 214 (§12, Programming the Analytical Engine); p. 217 (§14 and acknowledgments)
passages.note: Explicitly identifies Jacquard weaving as the source of the punched cards. Describes strings of perforated cards linked with ribbons after the loom’s manner, separate operation and variable card strings, and how card strings replaced the earlier control barrel.

file.representation: research notes with inspected PDF checksum
